public_rationale: The contemporaneous interview establishes promotion of AI features, but not aggressive upselling. The retrieved pricing page cannot establish what customers encountered before publication. Without dated customer communications or interface records, the claim is neither supported nor contradicted.
limitations: Public marketing material does not reveal account-specific prompts.
Aggressiveness requires judgment even when solicitation records exist.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Riverside has been aggressively upselling its AI services to customers.

statement.excerpt: Riverside has also aggressively been upselling customers on its AI services in a way that I find disgusting.

our_interpretation: Aggressively upselling means prominently and repeatedly encouraging existing customers to purchase additional AI services or upgrade for AI features.

The claim describes an ongoing practice. I use January 1 through publication on February 11, 2025 as the recent period in which customer communications and interface records could establish that practice.
The speaker's disgust is an opinion and is not assessed.
criteria.support_condition: Dated interface records or customer communications show prominent, repeated solicitations to pay more for AI services during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative records of customer interfaces and communications show that paid AI solicitations were absent or occasional and unobtrusive during the target period.
